versions.changelog:
- Version bumped to 1.1.0 with no user-visible changes.
- No updates to files or functionality detected.

- Initial release of yummy-gen-image skill.
- Enables AI-driven image generation and editing with Gemini via yummycli, supporting prompt-only and reference-image workflows.
- Unified CLI entry point for all flows: prompt-only, single-image editing, multi-image compositing.
- Follows user intent for model, aspect ratio, image size, and output path using clear mapping rules.
- Includes detailed contract for safe parameter selection and model compatibility.
